text:
jordan_partnerships: FYI — kickoff for joint observability announcement with Nebula (hardware) + Euler SI. Need to align dashboards (Datadog + OTLP), demo kit, and marketplace tile. Proposed target: two-week sprint, announcement in three weeks.

mike_eng: scope? is this just export + dashboards or deeper tracing hooks from our runtime?

kevin_obs: ideally both. basic OTLP export for metrics + traces + a Datadog dashboard bundle with 6 panels (latency p95/p99, token throughput, GPU utilization, KV-cache hit rate, trace waterfall for inference requests, error rate).

anna_prod: timeline note — marketing needs final assets 5 business days before announce. legal & partner ops sign-off required. can we land an internal demo next Tue?

priya_sales: sales enablement packet needed too: one-pager, pricing note for Dedicated, and a 5-min demo script. prefer doc by Wed.

nebula_hw: we can export firmware-level telemetry via OTLP collector. we'll provide sample collector config and a mapping of sensor names to metrics. also can supply a small lab rig for the demo next Tue.

mike_eng: ok, putting a quick OTLP collector sample here — tweak as needed:

```yaml
receivers:
  otlp:
    protocols:
      grpc: {}
      http: {}
exporters:
  logging:
processors:
  batch:
service:
  pipelines:
    metrics:
      receivers: [otlp]
      processors: [batch]
      exporters: [logging]
    traces:
      receivers: [otlp]
      processors: [batch]
      exporters: [logging]
```

kevin_obs: for Datadog bundle, sample panel list: 1) Inference latency (p50/p95/p99), 2) Token throughput (tokens/s), 3) GPU_utilization, 4) KV cache hit ratio, 5) Trace waterfall (span durations), 6) Error/count by model_version. I can mock JSON for the dashboard by EOD.

euler_si: SI team will own integration docs + one integration runbook (install collector, apply dashboard, verify). we can help with a checklist for customer on-prem installs.

anna_prod: new constraints — partner comms must reference certified models only. Jordan, can you confirm which model variants Nebula wants to highlight?

jordan_partnerships: Nebula wants to highlight 70B quantized variant + 13B low-latency variant. we'll include both in the demo matrix.

priya_sales: tagging pricing — is there any additional cost to customers for metric export to Datadog? need to confirm usage implications.

mike_eng: exporter is lightweight; the only extra is Datadog ingestion charges. we'll add a note in the sales packet.

nebula_hw: we'll share collector config and sample logs by EOD today. also can provide a short video of the rig boot and metrics coming through.

kevin_obs: two operational asks: 1) add an alert recipe for token-spike anomalies, 2) include an SLO example for 99.5% p95 latency. I'll draft alerts + SLO text.

ci-bot: deployment pipeline run — build #4523 succeeded (redwood/runtime -> canary) :white_check_mark:

anna_prod: ok milestones:
- Today: Nebula + SI provide collector + sample metrics (nebula_hw, euler_si)
- TOMORROW: kevin_obs dashboard mock; mike_eng to validate collector works with runtime
- Tue (internal demo): lab rig + demo script (priya_sales + anna_prod)
- Fri (assets due): one-pager, pricing note, partner legal sign-off (jordan_partnerships)
- +3 weeks: public announcement

jordan_partnerships: action owners: nebula_hw (collector + lab), euler_si (runbook + install checklist), kevin_obs (dashboard + alerts), mike_eng (collector validation), priya_sales (enablement pack), anna_prod (announce timeline & assets), me (partner approvals & PR). I'll follow up with a short calendar invite. :rocket:

mike_eng: quick question — do we want to include a tiny sample repo that runs a live trace to Datadog for the demo? I can scaffold it.

kevin_obs: yes please, simple python client that sends spans + metrics to OTLP collector, then points to Datadog. keeps demo reliable.

jordan_partnerships: perfect. keep comms in this thread; I'll ping legal offline for partner copy. thanks all :pray:
